name: Emberline Chat
purpose: ChatGPT-style chat app: users sign in, start conversations, send messages, and see assistant replies stream back through a pluggable AI provider adapter.
actors: Admin (viewer of app health, no per-user data access)

workflows.name: Sign in and start a conversation
workflows.description: Authenticate (password + optional OAuth), then create a new conversation with an auto title.

workflows.name: Send a message and stream a reply
workflows.description: User posts a message; the app appends it, calls the provider adapter, and streams the assistant reply back chunk by chunk; full reply is persisted.

workflows.name: Browse past conversations
workflows.description: Sidebar lists the user's conversations; opening one shows the full message history.

workflows.name: Rename or delete a conversation
workflows.description: Owner edits the title or removes the conversation and its messages.

integrations.name: AI chat provider (OpenAI-compatible chat completions, streaming)

seed_demo: Demo user with two sample conversations: one greeting exchange with a canned assistant reply, one with a longer multi-paragraph reply demonstrating streaming and formatting.
